blocks.prompt: 25 Solve the initial value problem \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + y}{x}\); \(y(1) = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
\(\frac{x + y}{x}\) ko tor kar likhein to \(1 + \frac{y}{x}\) banta hai, jo sirf \(y/x\) ka function hai; is liye equation homogeneous hai.
Saath mein condition \(y(1) = 1\) bhi di hai, yani yeh initial value problem hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + y}{x}\) aur \(y(1) = 1\). Find kya karna hai? Particular solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\); yahan \(v\) cancel hone ke baad sirf \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = 1\) bachta hai, jo sab se aasaan shakal hai.
Plan: \(y = vx\), integrate, \(v\) wapas, condition lagana, tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + y}{x}\), \(y(1) = 1\).
Maloom karna: particular solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation: \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\); phir condition se \(C\).

\(y = vx\) rakhein
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = 1 + v\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\frac{x + vx}{x} = \frac{x(1 + v)}{x} = 1 + v\). Dono taraf ka \(v\) cancel ho gaya.

Variables alag kar ke integrate karein
\[dv = \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
\[v = \ln|x| + C\]
Kyun: \(x\) se divide kar ke \(dx\) se multiply kiya. \(\int dv = v\) aur \(\int \frac{dx}{x} = \ln|x|\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan constant ko \(\ln|C|\) likhne ki zaroorat nahi, kyunke left side par log nahi; seedha \(C\) likhna behtar hai.

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[\dfrac{y}{x} = \ln|x| + C\]
\[y = x\ln|x| + Cx\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(x\) se multiply kiya. Yeh general solution hai: har \(C\) ke liye ek alag curve, aur condition batayegi ke in mein se kaunsi curve humari hai.

\(y(1) = 1\) lagayein
\[1 = 1\cdot\ln 1 + C(1)\]
\[C = 1\]
\[y = x + x\ln|x|\]
Kyun: \(\ln 1 = 0\), is liye \(C = 1\) seedha mil gaya. Phir \(C\) ki value general solution mein rakhi.

Tasdeeq
\[y' = 1 + \ln|x| + 1 = 2 + \ln|x|\]
\[\dfrac{x + y}{x} = 1 + 1 + \ln|x| = 2 + \ln|x|\]
Dono barabar hain \(\checkmark\); aur \(y(1) = 1 + 0 = 1\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: \(x\ln|x|\) par product rule: \(1\cdot\ln|x| + x\cdot\frac{1}{x} = \ln|x| + 1\). Equation aur condition dono poori hui.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 29 par chhapa hai, 25 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 29 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(y = x + x\ln|x|\), sahi hai.
